description: Business-layer SaaS capabilities. Selecting one injects its guidance into the architect and builder prompts so the generated app is a real, sellable SaaS — not just an app. Select per build via --saas or the dashboard.

billing.label: Billing & monetization
guidance: Stripe subscriptions with at least two priced plans + a free tier; checkout and a customer billing portal
Usage metering hooks for metered features; webhook handling for invoice/payment events
Entitlement checks gate premium features; handle dunning/past-due gracefully
Never store raw card data; use Stripe tokens/Checkout

multitenancy.label: Multi-tenancy & identity
guidance: Organizations/teams with membership and roles (owner/admin/member); every tenant-owned row is scoped by org_id
Enforce tenant isolation in every query; no cross-tenant data access
Invite flow; SSO-ready auth (OAuth/OIDC) with a path to SAML/SCIM for enterprise
Per-tenant settings and a tenant switcher in the UI

growth.label: Growth engineering
guidance: Marketing landing page with SEO meta/OG/sitemap and clear CTAs
Onboarding funnel with activation steps and sample/demo data
Lifecycle email hooks (welcome, activation, re-engagement) behind an email interface
Privacy-respecting product analytics + a feature-flag-based A/B experiment mechanism

support.label: Support surface
guidance: Status/health page, a CHANGELOG.md updated per release, and an in-app help/KB section
In-app feedback capture that files into the backlog
Clear, actionable error messages and a documented support contact

deepQa.label: Deeper QA
guidance: End-to-end tests across the primary browser (Playwright) covering core flows
Visual regression snapshots for key screens
A load/soak test (k6) for the hottest endpoints and a documented performance budget
Basic chaos/resilience check (dependency down → graceful degradation)

provenance.label: Supply-chain provenance
guidance: Generate and commit an SBOM (CycloneDX); diff it across releases in CI
Sign build artifacts/images (cosign) and produce SLSA provenance attestation in CI
Pin dependencies and commit lockfiles for reproducible builds

continuousDelivery.label: Continuous delivery
guidance: Zero-downtime deploys: expand/contract DB migrations, health-gated rollouts
Progressive delivery: canary or blue-green with automatic rollback on health regression
Feature flags for gradual feature rollout and kill-switches
